id: title:dmarchuk:keep edits queued behind a slow auto save

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves workflow name and version state during queued autosaves, preventing stale data display and supporting correct comparison against current form state.
review.reason: Adds an editVersion field and a helper to propagate the current version into queued save contexts, and adds a test asserting queued autosaves retain the latest user edits rather than reverting to an earlier payload. This supports correct comparison against the current form state and prevents stale data display. No tier assignment performed.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation and its relevance to PostHog, not on unverified outcomes or adoption. No tier assignment performed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test asserting that queued auto-saves retain the latest user edits rather than reverting to the payload of an earlier save.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves user-visible workflow name while queued saves are still in flight, preventing stale data from being displayed after a save response arrives.

observations.behavior: Adds an editVersion field to SaveContext and a keepQueuedSavesCurrent helper to propagate the current version into queued save contexts.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows queued save requests to carry the version of edits present when they were queued, rather than the version when the save was dispatched, supporting correct comparison against the current form state.

observations.behavior: Passes the current workflowEditVersion into the saveContext object when a save is dispatched.
observations.posthog_connection: Records the version of edits at dispatch time, establishing the baseline for queued saves to compare against the current form state.
